opportunity: Paid GitHub Action on GitHub Marketplace

process.step1_create_action: Create a public GitHub repository with action.yml (or Dockerfile) defining inputs, outputs, and runs. Use `gh repo create` CLI.
process.step2_package_action: Ensure action is in a public repo with a release tag (e.g., v1.0.0). Use `git tag` and `git push --tags`.
process.step3_list_on_marketplace: Go to https://github.com/marketplace/new (manual step: requires browser login). Fill in name, description, pricing (free/paid tiers). Paid tiers require Stripe Connect account setup via GitHub UI.
process.step4_set_pricing_tiers: In marketplace listing UI, define up to 10 paid plans (e.g., $5/month, $10/month). Each plan has a monthly price and optional per-unit pricing (e.g., per seat). No CLI/API for this.
process.step5_handle_billing: GitHub uses Stripe Connect for payments. Developer must link a Stripe account (manual: via GitHub Settings > Developer settings > Marketplace > Stripe Connect). GitHub collects payments, takes 5% revenue share (as of 2026, confirmed via GitHub docs). Payouts are monthly via Stripe.
process.step6_review_timeline: After submission, GitHub reviews within 5-10 business days. Manual review includes code scan, documentation check, and pricing verification. No CLI automation for submission or review.
manual_steps: Creating Stripe Connect account via GitHub UI

revenue_examples.action_name: Cortex XSOAR Action (by Palo Alto Networks)

revenue_examples.pricing: Free (public repos) + paid (private repos via SonarCloud)

estimated_monthly_revenue_for_new_action: Assuming $5/month plan, 100 subscribers: $500 gross, $475 after 5% GitHub cut. Realistic for niche actions (e.g., custom code quality checks) after 6-12 months of marketing.
implementation_complexity: Medium (requires action development, Stripe setup, manual listing)
revenue_share: GitHub takes 5% of all transactions (as of 2026, per GitHub Marketplace Terms). Developer receives 95% via Stripe payouts.
